specification.acceptance: All five fresh clean-source jobs complete. All source/runtime/input/protocol bindings pass, all required tile hashes pass, all features and predictions are finite, six-class joins match, and saved estimators replay. Record any convergence warning or iteration cap; do not change the 2000-iteration recipe after test outcomes.

amendment.reason: Allow float32 probability-row rounding without changing probabilities, classification, features, optimizer or test selection. The first original job failed its 1e-12 sum validation after fitting raw intensity statistics. Preserve the failed output and execute all five folds in new directories.

specification.controls: One majority rule per fold. Five categorical prediction draws from the training class prior, seeds 0..4. Their probability rows are the prior sampling distribution, not a claim that predictions are its argmax.
specification.estimator_state: Persist all four fitted scikit-learn pipelines as trusted joblib artifacts. Reload each locally and require exact predicted classes and probability agreement within absolute 1e-12. Record resolved parameters, n_iter, warnings, classes, feature slices and file hashes.
specification.feature_cache: One combined 1865-column float32 NPY array per role, with catalog-order ID and label arrays. Intensity columns 0:13, histogram 13:45, texture 45:1865, combined 0:1865. Raw tile hashes checked before feature extraction. No validation or Selk feature extraction.
specification.feature_semantics: The historical raw_intensity_statistics key contains statistics of normalized display values. Histogram and texture functions additionally apply their existing within-image percentile transform. Inputs are not calibrated backscatter.
limitations: Reference labels are interpretations of the same imagery; these metrics are map agreement.
Fold 1 has one Crater test tile; all five test supports remain visible.
This protocol is written after the frozen-model results but before the repaired classical fits; it reuses the existing feature recipes.
Numeric equality across library builds is not guaranteed. Runtime versions are pinned to the captured server environment.
Joblib files are executable Python serialization and must only be loaded from verified trusted run artifacts.
specification.normalization: Reuse the verified frozen fold training membership, pixel sample and scaling exactly. Reject missing/empty samples or any provenance digest mismatch. StandardScaler sees training features only.

recipe.convergence: retain and flag capped or warned fits; no automatic refit or tuning
recipe.input: training-normalized and clipped HiSAR display DN; dataset fill behavior unchanged
recipe.other_estimator_parameters: unchanged library defaults; exact runtime pinned and resolved parameters recorded
recipe.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training features only

specification.reporting: All six classes. Preserve exact ordered IDs, true labels, predicted labels, all six probability columns, confusion counts, supports and macro/per-class precision/recall/F1. One observation per deterministic method/fold. Average random-prior draws within each fold before descriptive equal-fold mean and sample SD. No confidence intervals or independent-repeat claim.
specification.scope: Repaired within-Titan classical baselines; five CPU fold jobs, four logistic-regression fits per fold
